recognize_zh: 骨髓切片右側大片區域失去造血細胞，呈淡粉紅的水腫/壞死基質，其中可見許多淡藍紫色細長絲狀結構（菌絲輪廓），夾雜紅血球外滲與棕色含鐵血黃素，左側殘存造血組織與脂肪。
features: Large paucicellular zone of pale eosinophilic edematous/necrotic stroma replacing hematopoietic tissue
Numerous faint pale basophilic slender filamentous structures (probable fungal hyphae) within the paucicellular area
Extravasated red cells and scattered brown hemosiderin-laden macrophages
Residual hematopoietic cells and fat spaces at the left; bony trabeculae at upper right
No granulomas or well-formed abscess evident in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a large area in which hematopoietic elements are replaced by pale, eosinophilic, edematous to necrotic stroma containing extravasated red cells, scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages and numerous faint, slender, basophilic filamentous structures suggestive of fungal hyphae. Residual cellular hematopoietic marrow with fat is present at the periphery, and bony trabeculae are seen. Well-formed granulomas are not identified. Findings are suggestive of invasive fungal infection of the marrow with associated stromal injury, to be confirmed with GMS/PAS stains and culture.

ddx.vs: Gelatinous transformation shows pale amorphous extracellular matrix around atrophic fat without filamentous organisms, hemorrhage or necrosis.

ddx.dx: Bone marrow necrosis (non-infectious, e.g., sickle cell or tumor)
ddx.vs: Ischemic necrosis shows ghost cells and granular eosinophilic debris without intervening hyphal structures, which GMS would exclude.

ddx.dx: Post-chemotherapy marrow aplasia with stromal edema
ddx.vs: Post-therapy aplasia shows dilated sinusoids, edema and fat but lacks filamentous organisms; special stains are negative.
Fibrotic marrow shows streaming collagen/reticulin with atypical megakaryocytes rather than loose edematous stroma with hyphae and hemorrhage.
